correctness.rationale: The crown order polytope has 12 actual facets: 3 lower a-bounds, 3 upper b-bounds and 6 cross-order inequalities. Their primitive incidence normals are totally unimodular. Dependence cycles in the active graph are exactly the 6 rooted four-circuits (three all-zero A and three all-one B) and the root-free six-circuit. These yield six maximal singular 3-faces and one independent singular segment; toric orbit-face correspondence yields seven irreducible singular components. Square-pyramid faces define quadric-cone threefolds, circuit duals give rank-one 2x2 (multiplicity 2) and 3x3 (multiplicity 6) generic transverse Segre cones. Independent exact facet-intersection/rank reconstruction of all 4096 facet subsets recovered 18 polytope vertices, 403 faces, six 3-dimensional + one 1-dimensional maximal singular faces and singular orbit counts (17,43,30,6). Pair face intersections give 6 lines/3 points/6 empty pairs among six cones. Dimension and characteristic boundaries explicitly respected.
